segments.title: April
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! April is our birthday month. Nine years of Physique 57, and the theme is Cloud Nine. The confetti budget has been approved. So has the target.

segments.title: ₹15.1L
segments.text: So, the number. Our April target for Kenkere House is 15.1 lakh rupees. That's 24 per cent above last April. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 8 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 5.13 lakh, everything else 1.06 lakh, and comebacks 90,600. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 76 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 1128 leads, 406 trials, and 76 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Six offers carry 9.59 lakh rupees, which is 63 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Cloud Nine Limited Edition
segments.text: First up, the headliner, Cloud Nine Limited Edition. Nine months, nine freezes, plus one month on us. That's 2 buyers, for 2.4 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members on 1 Month or class packs.

segments.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
segments.text: Next, Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend who joins and get nine bonus days. That's 5 buyers, for 62,000 rupees.

segments.title: Party Crasher Pass
segments.text: Then, for newcomers, the Party Crasher Pass. Three classes, including the birthday party class, at a tiny price that comes off their first month if they join. That's 9 buyers, for 1.05 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Where Are They Now?
segments.text: Also this month, for old friends, Where Are They Now? Fifteen per cent off to come back, a bonus class for every year they've known us, and a seat at the Throwback Reunion. That's 10 buyers, for 1.24 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Standard lapsed 15% + max 3 bonus classes (≤20% effective on a 12-class pack)

segments.title: Spin Class (Literally)
segments.text: After that, Spin Class, literally. Renew in April for ten per cent off, then spin the Wheel of Nine. That's 23 buyers, for 3.02 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Club Nine: The Founders' Table
segments.text: And finally, Club Nine, The Founders' Table. Nine numbered annual seats per studio, with double the perks, a numbered jacket, and a name on the wall. That's 1 buyer, for 1.25 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, the numbered memberships go live, with a public counter. Week two, the party class brings new faces in, and every guest gets a follow-up. Week three, the wheel spins and the Club Nine seats close. Week four, the Throwback Reunion brings old friends home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's April at Kenkere House. 15.1 lakh rupees, six offers, and 76 buyers to welcome. Nine years in, and honestly? We've never looked better.
